_comment: Curated core-item (锅具/道具/桌台) id -> icon sprite name. Most core items (Counter, Sink, Conveyor, etc.) have NO 2D icon in the bundles (they are 3D models) and are left out — the layout canvas falls back to a text label for those. id = catalog item id (prefab filename without extension). icon-overrides.json[catalog] takes precedence. Edit freely; re-run extract-icons.py.
